description: Welcome home to 3831 Cottonwood Grove Trail! Nestled in the highly desirable Deersprings community of Calabasas, this beautifully updated four-bedroom, two and one-half bathroom residence offers the perfect combination of comfort, privacy, and style. Situated on one of the neighborhood's larger lots with no home directly behind, this property provides the peaceful backdrop and sense of space that today's buyers are looking for.As you step inside, you're greeted by soaring high ceilings and an abundance of natural light that fills the formal living room, creating an airy, open feel. The adjacent formal dining room—complete with French doors leading out to the backyard—sets the stage for intimate dinners or lively gatherings. Every space in this home has been thoughtfully designed to balance elegance and warmth, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining.The open-concept great room serves as the heart of the home, featuring an updated kitchen with crisp cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, granite counters, and a breakfast bar that flows seamlessly into the family room. Anchored by a cozy fireplace, the family room offers the perfect spot to relax after a long day or enjoy movie nights with loved ones. A convenient powder bathroom is located on the main floor, ideal for guests.Upstairs, the spacious primary suite is a tranquil retreat with vaulted ceilings and a private en-suite bathroom with dual vanities. Three additional bedrooms—each generously sized—share a full hall bathroom with updated finishes. Whether you need space for family, guests, or a home office, this floor plan offers flexibility to suit a variety of lifestyles.Step outside and discover your own private oasis. With no home directly behind, the backyard feels exceptionally private—perfect for relaxing, gardening, or entertaining outdoors. The large lot provides ample space for outdoor dining, play, and even the potential to add a pool or spa, should you desire. The possibilities are endless.Additional highlights include a two-car garage with direct home access, a tankless water heater and laundry room. This home has been well cared for and tastefully updated, offering a move-in ready opportunity in one of Calabasas' most sought-after neighborhoods.The Deersprings community is known for its tree-lined streets, convenient access to local amenities, and proximity to nature. You'll love being just minutes away from scenic hiking and biking trails, neighborhood parks, and the charming Calabasas Commons—offering shopping, dining, and entertainment. Commuters appreciate the easy access to the 101 Freeway, and families benefit from attendance in the award-winning Las Virgenes Unified School District, known for its top-rated schools.If you've been searching for a beautifully maintained home in a prime Calabasas location with the perfect blend of privacy, space, and convenience—your search ends here.Welcome home to 3831 Cottonwood Grove Trail—where comfort meets Calabasas living at its finest.
